description: Defines a recursive data storage class 'Value' for storing settings and persistable data, supporting JSON-compatible types, along with related classes 'DictionaryValue' and 'ListValue'. Includes method declarations, class definitions, and serialization interfaces.

classes.name: Value
classes.description: A variant-like class supporting JSON-compatible data types with methods for hierarchy navigation, modification, and deep copying.

classes.name: DictionaryValue
classes.description: A key-value dictionary class derived from Value, supporting path-based access and modification.

classes.name: ListValue
classes.description: A list of Value objects, supporting list operations and iteration.

methods.name: CreateWithCopiedBuffer
methods.description: Creates a new binary Value by copying the provided buffer.

methods.name: FromUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Converts a unique_ptr<Value> to a Value.

methods.name: ToUniquePtrValue
methods.description: Converts a Value to a unique_ptr<Value>.

methods.name: GetTypeName
methods.description: Returns the string name of a given Value::Type.

methods.name: Clone
methods.description: Creates a deep copy of the Value object.

methods.name: FindKey
methods.description: Finds a key in a dictionary Value.

methods.name: SetKey
methods.description: Sets a key in a dictionary Value.

methods.name: RemoveKey
methods.description: Removes a key from a dictionary Value.

methods.name: FindPath
methods.description: Finds a nested Value by path.

methods.name: SetPath
methods.description: Sets a nested Value by path, creating intermediate dictionaries as needed.

methods.name: RemovePath
methods.description: Removes a nested Value by path.

methods.name: DeepCopyWithoutEmptyChildren
methods.description: Creates a copy excluding empty dictionaries and lists.

methods.name: MergeDictionary
methods.description: Recursively merges another dictionary into this one.
